name: goal-first
description: The person typed the goal before its premises, so in Inbox.lean the target's block comes first. Claude formalises the three cards below their blocks; its first proof, right after the target's statement, does not build (the premises' .holds come later in the file), so it moves the proof to the end of the subject's namespace in Inbox.lean, checks and finishes proved.
subject: Demo

steps.newString:
namespace Demo

/-- beings -/
axiom Being : Type
/-- there is at least one being -/
axiom Being.exists : Nonempty Being
instance : Nonempty Being := Being.exists
/-- is human -/
axiom Human : Being → Prop
/-- is mortal -/
axiom Mortal : Being → Prop
/-- Socrates -/
noncomputable opaque socrates : Being

end Demo

steps.oldString:
natural_name: Socrates is mortal
premises: all-humans-are-mortal, socrates-is-a-human
asserted: 2026-11-10
-/
steps.newString:
natural_name: Socrates is mortal
premises: all-humans-are-mortal, socrates-is-a-human
asserted: 2026-11-10
-/
/-- Socrates is mortal -/
abbrev socrates_is_mortal : Prop := Mortal socrates

steps.oldString:
natural_name: All humans are mortal
asserted: 2026-11-10
-/
steps.newString:
natural_name: All humans are mortal
asserted: 2026-11-10
-/
/-- All humans are mortal -/
abbrev all_humans_are_mortal : Prop := ∀ x : Being, Human x → Mortal x
axiom all_humans_are_mortal.holds : all_humans_are_mortal

steps.oldString:
natural_name: Socrates is a human
asserted: 2026-11-10
-/
steps.newString:
natural_name: Socrates is a human
asserted: 2026-11-10
-/
/-- Socrates is a human -/
abbrev socrates_is_a_human : Prop := Human socrates
axiom socrates_is_a_human.holds : socrates_is_a_human

abbrev socrates_is_mortal : Prop := Mortal socrates
theorem socrates_is_mortal.holds : socrates_is_mortal :=
  all_humans_are_mortal.holds socrates socrates_is_a_human.holds
